document.abstract: Kodak Vision 800T Color Negative Film 5289/7289 leverages advances in emulsion and manufacturing technologies, which make it more sensitive to light without amplifying grain. Tim Waygood takes you through a technical demonstration of the world's fastest motion picture film along with an example of the new KODAK Vision Color print films.
